answer: Rule: every identity must hold one unique shard of the grove ledger, 500 MB, proven each epoch to the kernel with a Merkle proof; fail twice and the identity dies with its 50 POA bond burned. Shards are assigned at random, so a farm of 100 fakes must store 50 GB and answer 100 proofs per epoch, a juniper that never sheds its load: storage and bandwidth costs scale linearly with every fake, and buying disks costs more than any fake earns.
